descriptionHtml:
Bug B19 · excluded (All tickets still in progress / ready for PR (not counted, Quinn 2026-10-14)) · was P1

Retention / purge is not implemented per UAT 3.6: 13-hour Important Points and 37-hour tasks, handoffs and vitals are still there; nothing is purged unless a device opens the app; past 500 patients some charts are skipped

Tickets: TFA-94699 in progress · counts as a QA bug: no (ticket in progress) · found on: local

Note: One root cause behind 19 cases; the windows themselves are decision D6

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-04/S01, OAT-04/S07, OAT-04/S08, OAT-04/S11, OAT-04/S14, OAT-04/S15, OAT-04/S17, OAT-04/S23, OAT-04/S24, OAT-04/S26, OAT-04/S27, TC-10/S21, TC-11/S25, TC-12/S05, TC-13/S15, TC-13/S16, TC-12/S29, TC-13/S29

Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S04 Nursing Home counterpart: last two visits kept, older visits deleted, chronic meds and open tasks persist, short windows and handoffs

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U9 Nursing Home keeps the last two visits: notes, transcripts and medication events from older visits are deleted; the chronic medication list and open tasks persist until changed; … (UAT OAT-04 (B); UAT 3.6 (Nursing Home: pre-round 12 h, encounter 12 h, note 18 h, last two visits); UAT 3.3; TFA-94699 AC 1 (Nursing Home line)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U1 Deletion is a hard delete, not a hidden flag: every record that clears (at its window, or when a patient or account is deleted) is gone from the database, queryable as gone, and is not merely hidden … (UAT OAT-04; UAT OAT-04 step 2; TFA-94699 AC 1; TFA-92568 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress; TFA-92568 in progress
  • U8 Handoffs are deleted 36 h after they were sent: a handoff sent 37 h ago is gone from the database, for sender and recipient alike. (UAT OAT-04 (B); UAT OAT-04 step 1; TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: handoffs 36 h after sent)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U11 Live patient data never survives past its window: once an item clears, no copy of it remains anywhere live (other fields of the chart, dated histories, the patient-list row, handoffs, drafts). … (UAT OAT-04 Expected 2; UAT 3.7 (retention claim)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Fresh physician with two synthetic Nursing Home residents. Resident 1, through the aging helper: three completed visits (10, 5 and 2 days ago), each with a note, a transcript and a medication event; a chronic medication list unchanged since visit 1; an open task added at visit 1; pre-round text processed 13 h ago; …

When The Nursing Home purge runs, then the raw resident document is read with admin access

Then Resident 1: visit 1's note, transcript and medication events are gone; visits 2 and 3 are kept whole; the chronic medication list and the open task are kept; the 13 h pre-round text and the 13 h Important Point are gone; the 17 h completed task is judged per Q18; the 37 h handoff per Q8 / Q20. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-04 (B) and 3.6 Nursing Home: any trace of 'V1-7731' left = Fail; 'V2-7732' or 'V3-7733' missing, the chronic list or the open task missing, or the 13 h pre-round text present = Fail. The 13 h Important Point present = Fail (TC-12 step 6 'Repeat in Nursing Home' + 3.3; clock anchor Q3). Resident 2's encounter or note still on the working tab = Fail; …

Where it ran: local retention (clock moved to check retention); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: manual (blocked)

S04 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; to be decided by Daniela.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92568 in progress; TFA-94699 in progress

In the Nursing Home the oldest of three visits (its note, transcript and medication events) is still on the resident's chart, and a 13 h-old Important Point is still shown.

Evidence: allure b2f2c9bf-…-result.json; retention lane. 17 checks pass, 2 fail, both known: K7 (NH keeps 3 visits; already in dev report §3 as by design, for Daniela) and K14 (NH Important Points never expire). Recorded against Q18 (NH done tasks), Q8/Q20 (NH handoffs) and Q17.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane retention.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: retention.

UAT item: OAT-04 Data Retention · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-04/S04

Nursing Home counterpart: last two visits kept, older visits deleted, chronic meds and open tasks persist, short windows and handoffs

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress); TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

New local lane retention: status failed in retention/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (retention/plan.json, automatable: yes): API spec: resident 1 with three back-dated visits (snfVisitDates, transcriptHistory archives, previousNotes, single-dose/changed med rows tagged V1/V2/V3), chronic list unchanged since visit 1, open task from visit 1, pre-round 13 h, point 13 h, done task 17 h, handoff 37 h; resident 2 encounter 13 h + note 19 h. snf:applyLifecycle, raw rows. — Visits are seeded through snf:add/update with dated stamps (no Generate needed); Q17/Q18/Q8/Q20 parts recorded, not judged.

Where it ran: local

Detail:

17 judged items passed, 2 failed (2 known, 0 policy conflict, 0 not in the matrix knownGaps), 3 recorded against open questions — failed: V1.gone (any trace of visit 1 ('V1-7731': note, transcript, medication events): expected absent, got present (medications+previousNotes+transcriptHistory); known K7) | point13 (Important Point written 13 h ago: expected absent, got present; known K14) — record-only: doneTask17 = deleted [Q18 (NH completed tasks: no window in 3.6 NH or the ticket)] | handoff37 = kept with its text on both sides (sender recipient) [Q8 / Q20 (does 36 h apply to NH handoffs; what may remain)] | R2.where = encounter in transcriptHistory; note in previousNotes [Q17 (moved into the visit history or deleted; does the move count as a visit, Q9)] — notes: Visits are three back-dated visits (10, 5, 2 days ago) in snfVisitDates, transcriptHistory (archivedAt), previousNotes (addedAt) and one single-dose row per visit plus a visit-1 dose change; what counts as a visit is Q9.

Product issue: In the Nursing Home the oldest of three visits (its note, transcript and medication events) is still on the resident's chart, and a 13 h-old Important Point is still shown. Breaks UAT 3.6 Nursing Home 'last two visits' / OAT-04 (B) and TC-12 step 6. Known in the matrix: K7, K14.

Evidence: 1 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Needs the aging helper (a test-only internal mutation that moves a chart's stamps back, called with the local stack's admin key) and the retention-db runner, which seeds through e2e/support/backend.ts and reads the raw rows with adminQuery; dev has no admin key and the dev runner calls only the l…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
